meta.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, GSR 202(E) dated 7 March 2011, as amended (incl. GSR 748(E) dated 24.10.2011 w.e.f. 01.07.2012, and GSR 629(E) dated 23.6.2017)
meta.note: Numeral height tables (Rule 7 Table-I/II) and exemptions (Rule 26) below are transcribed from the official rules text. Re-verify against the current consolidated gazette copy before your final demo -- rules are amended periodically (2017, and again per 2025 DoCA FAQ clarifications).

scope_exclusions.message: Chapter II retail-sale declaration rules do not apply -- package exceeds 25 kg/25 L (cement/fertilizer bags up to 50kg are the exception).
Package is for institutional/industrial consumption -- Chapter II retail declaration rules do not apply.

exemptions.message: Package net content is 10g/10ml or less -- fully exempt from these rules.
Fast food packed by a restaurant/hotel is exempt.
Scheduled/non-scheduled drug formulations under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995 are exempt from these rules (governed separately).
Agricultural farm produce above 50kg is exempt.
Bidis/incense sticks and PSU-marketed domestic LPG cylinders (14.2kg/5kg) do not require a manufacture-date declaration.
Bidis and APM-priced domestic LPG cylinders do not require an MRP declaration on-pack.

mandatory_declarations.message: Name and complete address of manufacturer/packer/importer is missing.
Common/generic name of the commodity is missing.
Net quantity missing or not in a standard SI unit (g/kg/ml/l, or N/U for number).
Net quantity declaration contains a misleading qualifier word (e.g. 'about', 'approximately').
Month and year of manufacture/packing/import is missing or invalid.
MRP missing, or not declared as 'MRP Rs.___ inclusive of all taxes'.
Consumer care details missing phone/email contact.
Country of origin / importer address missing for an imported product.
Dimensions of the commodity (e.g. bedsheets, towels, sarees) are required but missing.

font_and_placement_rules.message: Declaration letter height is below the 1 mm (2 mm if embossed/molded) minimum.
Letter/numeral width is less than one-third of its height.
Numeral height for MRP/net quantity does not meet Table-I minimum for its weight/volume band.
Numeral height for MRP/net quantity does not meet Table-II minimum for the PDP area band.
One or more mandatory declarations were found outside the calculated Principal Display Panel area.
Area around the net quantity declaration is not sufficiently free of other printed text (needs clear space >=1x height above/below, >=2x height left/right).
MRP/net quantity is not printed at least as prominently, and in a contrasting colour, as required.

language_rule.message: Declaration text is not in Hindi (Devanagari) or English (a regional language may be added, not substituted).
